# Create PR

`tailrocks-create-pr` — part of [tailrocks-skills](../../README.md) · [documentation](https://skills.tailrocks.com/docs/skills/tailrocks-create-pr)

Open a pull request for the current change in any repository: branch, commit in the repo's convention, body from its template, render check. Extended by .tailrocks/pr.md. Do not use to refresh or merge an existing PR.

## Invocation

This skill never activates on its own. Name it in your request:

> Use `tailrocks-create-pr` …

Arguments: `[--branch <name>|--auto-branch] [--title <msg>] [--base <branch>] [--draft]`
